clinical_intent: For a cervical cancer brachytherapy case, the tandem is placed at an angle of 60 degrees from the horizontal. If the tandem length is 6 cm and the source dwell positions are spaced at 5 mm intervals, calculate the expected dose rate at Point A (2 cm lateral and 2 cm superior from the tandem tip) using the TG-43 formalism for an Ir-192 source with an air-kerma strength of 40,000 uCi.
